text: India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947.
The Constitution of India came into effect on 26 January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day.
New Delhi is the capital of India.
Hyderabad is the capital of the Indian state of Telangana.
Telangana was formed as a separate state of India on 2 June 2014, carved out of Andhra Pradesh.
Telugu is a Dravidian language and the official language of the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
The Godavari is the second longest river in India after the Ganga.
The Venkateswara Temple at Tirumala is located in Tirupati district of Andhra Pradesh.
India's Chandrayaan-3 lander Vikram landed near the south pole of the Moon on 23 August 2023, making India the first country to land near the lunar south pole.
ISRO's Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) entered orbit around Mars on 24 September 2014; India was the first country to reach Mars orbit on its first attempt.
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is headquartered in Bengaluru.
Apollo 11 landed the first humans, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, on the Moon on 20 July 1969.
The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank and is responsible for issuing banknotes.
On 8 November 2016 the Government of India announced the demonetisation of all 500 and 1000 rupee banknotes.
In May 2023 the Reserve Bank of India announced the withdrawal of 2000 rupee notes from circulation, but they continued to remain legal tender.
Indian 2000 rupee banknotes do not contain any GPS or nano chip; viral claims about a tracking chip were false.
UNESCO has never declared India's national anthem Jana Gana Mana as the best national anthem in the world; the message is a hoax.
Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued to residents of India by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI).
The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).
The Statue of Unity in Gujarat, depicting Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, is 182 metres tall and is the tallest statue in the world.
According to United Nations estimates, India overtook China as the world's most populous country in 2023.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth above sea level, with an official height of 8,848.86 metres.
The Earth orbits the Sun approximately once every 365.25 days.
The Earth is roughly spherical in shape, slightly flattened at the poles.
At sea level, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
COVID-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus.
The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
5G mobile networks do not spread COVID-19; viruses cannot travel on radio waves or mobile networks.
Eating garlic or drinking hot water does not prevent or cure COVID-19, according to the World Health Organization.
Scientific studies have found no link between vaccines and autism.
Antibiotics do not work against viral infections such as the common cold or influenza.
Microwave ovens heat food using non-ionizing radiation and do not make food radioactive.
Humans use virtually all of their brain; the claim that people use only 10 percent of the brain is a myth.
Lightning can and often does strike the same place more than once.
Non-avian dinosaurs became extinct about 66 million years ago, long before humans appeared.
Global average surface temperature has risen by more than 1 degree Celsius since pre-industrial times, mainly because of human greenhouse gas emissions.
Drinking cow urine has not been scientifically shown to cure cancer or COVID-19.
Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated on 30 January 1948 in New Delhi.
The Taj Mahal in Agra was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
